mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 256.3 points to accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of tighter policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 256.3 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the CPIAUCSL crossing above 256.3, or the inflationary effect dissipates within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) create a reinforcing cycle, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases from previous quarter and FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% for next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not significantly outperform baseline when both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS meet the trigger conditions, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 152,000 signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 152,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite PAYEMS crossing above 152,000, or the labor market strength does not translate to immediate stock gains (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicates a robust labor market, fostering consumer confidence and corporate growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE remains below 4.0% for next 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly when UNRATE stays below 4.0% (p > 0.05), or the labor market strength does not materialize into stock gains.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing demand (HOUST) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 2.5%) creates a synergistic effect, lowering borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases from previous month and FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% for next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not significantly outperform baseline when both HOUST and FEDFUNDS meet the trigger conditions, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and sub-4% unemployment (UNRATE) signal expansionary monetary policy, reducing real interest rates and stimulating investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE < 3.5% for next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions, or the policy effect is diluted (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index above its 5-month moving average reflects stronger production capacity, which reduces supply-side bottlenecks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly when INDPRO's 5-month moving average increases (p > 0.05), or the supply-side improvement does not translate to stock gains.
